blurb.en: Semi-modular sequencer-synth with a patchbay and a personality that argues with you. First revision.
blurb.fi: Puolimodulaarinen sekvensseri-syna patchbaylla ja luonteella, joka väittää vastaan. Ensimmäinen versio.
blurb.sv: Halvmodulär sekvensiator-synt med patchbay och ett humör som säger emot. Första revisionen.

pull.q: It keeps the micro patch bay and battery-powered portability of past devices but trades cheap acrylic cases for a sturdy aluminium enclosure.

quotes.t: This button is my only real gripe with the softPop — it would have been really helpful if there was a way to trigger this with the patchbay.
The black panel, fiddly switches and small buttons don't lend themselves to playing in a dark club.
